description: Composite figure pairing a property table with a 12-panel EBSD map array. Top: a table listing tensile properties and microstructural constituent fractions for cold-rolled (CR) and annealed duplex low-density steel specimens DP950-1, DP950-5, DP1000-1, DP1000-5, DP1000-5-TD and DP1050-1 — YS (MPa), UTS (MPa), TE (%), SYS and SUTS (MPa·g⁻¹·cm³), Rex-γ fraction (%), γ grain size (µm), ferrite fraction by XRD (%) and α and δ fractions by EBSD (%). Bottom: two rows of EBSD maps, each with a 20 µm scale bar, under a column header CR, DP950-1, DP950-5, DP1000-1, DP1000-5, DP1050-1. Row PH (a1–f1) shows phase mappings with a colour key: FCC (austenite) light blue, BCC (ferrite) red; arrows label shear bands in a1, b1, c1 and annealing twins in c1–f1. Row GROD-Austenite (a2–f2) maps grain-reference-orientation-deviation of austenite with a colour key red = 2°–180°, yellow = 0°–2°, where dark lines are high-angle austenite grain boundaries above 15°; an orientation inset gives ND (up) and RD (right). CR (a2) is mostly pink, i.e. deformed; from DP950-5 onward the maps become yellow with black ferrite bands, marking progressive recrystallization. Red ferrite bands are thickest in c1 and become thinner and more discontinuous toward f1.

observations.observation: The EBSD phase maps use a two-colour key: FCC austenite is light blue and BCC ferrite is red; the red phase forms elongated bands aligned with the horizontal (RD) direction in every annealed specimen.

In the CR phase map (a1) arrows labelled 'Shear bands' indicate elongated red features in the blue FCC matrix, and the corresponding GROD map (a2) is dominated by pink/red (GROD 2°–180°), showing a deformed, non-recrystallized austenite.
Panels (c1)–(f1) carry annotations 'Annealing twin + shear band' (c1) and 'Annealing twins' (d1, e1, f1), with arrows pointing to thin parallel twin lamellae inside austenite.
Every EBSD map carries a 20 µm scale bar, and the orientation inset in (f2) indicates ND vertical and RD horizontal.
The GROD-Austenite colour key is red for 2°–180° and yellow for 0°–2°, with dark lines marking high-angle austenite grain boundaries (>15°).

The red BCC (ferrite) bands are thickest in (c1) for DP950-5 and become progressively thinner and more discontinuous in (d1)–(f1), consistent with the decreasing ferrite fractions listed in the table.
The table gives YS from 905±15 MPa (DP1050-1) to 1075±10 MPa (DP1000-1) and UTS from 1190±15 MPa (DP1000-5-TD) to 1440±10 MPa (DP950-1).
Total elongation in the table increases from 5.2±0.2 % (DP950-1) to 47.5±1.0 % (DP1050-1), with DP1000-5 at 41.4±0.5 % and DP1000-5-TD at 18.1±0.4 %.
The Rex-γ fraction column rises monotonically from 7.9 % (CR) through 19.4 % (DP950-1) and 54.8 % (DP950-5) to 91.6 % (DP1000-1), 95.2 % (DP1000-5 and DP1000-5-TD) and 96.8 % (DP1050-1).
The α fraction by EBSD peaks at 23.8 % and the δ fraction by EBSD peaks at 12.1 %, both in DP950-5, then fall to 2.7 % (α) and 4.6 % (δ) in DP1050-1.

Austenite γ grain size listed in the table is largest for CR (15.38±16.47 µm) and DP950-1 (14.64±8.88 µm) and smallest for DP1000-1 (5.13±4.74 µm), rising again to 7.40±5.13 µm (DP1000-5 and DP1000-5-TD) and 9.65±8.17 µm (DP1050-1).
SYS and SUTS peak at 169.0±1.6 MPa·g⁻¹·cm³ (DP1000-1) and 226.4±1.6 MPa·g⁻¹·cm³ (DP950-1) respectively, and decrease toward DP1050-1 (142.3±2.4 and 189.5±1.6).

The caption states that (a1–f1) are phase (PH) mappings and (a2–f2) are grain-reference-orientation-deviation (GROD) mappings of austenite, and that the microstructures were formed after different annealing processes.
The citing text states that the Rexed fraction in austenite was determined from the GROD mappings by setting the GROD value below 2°.

The citing text states that ferrite in the CR specimen has two morphologies: granular grains at austenite triple points (0.6–1.8 µm) and bands elongated along RD (12–30 µm long, 2–6 µm thick), the bands being δ ferrite.

subfigures.description: Property table with columns CR, DP950-1, DP950-5, DP1000-1, DP1000-5, DP1000-5-TD, DP1050-1 and rows YS (MPa), UTS (MPa), TE (%), SYS (MPa·g⁻¹·cm³), SUTS (MPa·g⁻¹·cm³), Rex-γ fraction (%), γ grain size (µm), ferrite fraction by XRD (%), α fraction by EBSD (%), δ fraction by EBSD (%). CR values are mostly '-' except Rex-γ 7.9%, γ grain size 15.38±16.47 µm, XRD ferrite 12.6%, α 5.7%, δ 5.4%.
Phase map of CR: light-blue FCC matrix with red BCC regions; two arrows labelled 'Shear bands' point to elongated red features. Colour key at lower left: FCC light blue, BCC red. 20 µm scale bar.
GROD map of austenite for CR: dominated by pink/red (GROD 2°–180°) with scattered yellow (0°–2°) regions, i.e. a largely deformed austenite; black high-angle boundaries.
Phase map of DP950-1: abundant red banded ferrite elongated along the horizontal (RD) direction in the blue FCC matrix, with a label 'shear bands'.
GROD map of DP950-1: mixed yellow and red/pink regions with heavy black boundary network, indicating partial recrystallization.
Phase map of DP950-5: thickest red ferrite bands; annotation reads 'Annealing twin + shear band'.
GROD map of DP950-5: predominantly yellow with black ferrite bands, indicating advanced recrystallization.
Phase map of DP1000-1: thinner, more interrupted red ferrite bands in blue FCC matrix; annotation 'Annealing twins' with arrows to thin parallel lines inside austenite.
GROD map of DP1000-1: almost entirely yellow with black elongated ferrite bands, i.e. fully recrystallized austenite.
Phase map of DP1000-5: sparse, thin red ferrite bands; annotation 'Annealing twins'.
GROD map of DP1000-5: uniform yellow with black ferrite bands and dark high-angle boundaries.
Phase map of DP1050-1: dispersed, small red ferrite regions in blue FCC matrix; annotation 'Annealing twins'.
GROD map of DP1050-1: uniform yellow with black ferrite bands; inset orientation axes show ND pointing up and RD pointing right (TD is the third axis).

unreadable_items: Table cell for 'Ferrite fraction by XRD (%)' in the DP1000-1 column appears empty (no value printed), so the XRD ferrite fraction of DP1000-1 cannot be read

Fine internal annotation text in panels (c1)–(f1) is small; the labels were read as 'Annealing twin + shear band' (c1) and 'Annealing twins' (d1, e1, f1) but are only partly legible at the supplied resolution
The table header for the first data column is read as 'CR'; individual panel index labels (a1–f2) are small but legible
